name: The Wolf Of All Streets
zh_summary: Scott Melker 討論上市是否真的關於股價上漲，引用 Dan Held 說 IPO 提供流動性和對沖方式，對 Kraken 尚未上市感到失望，指出 Coinbase 自 IPO 以來下跌 50%，公開市場意味著活躍交易和流動性而非僅數字上漲。
en_summary: Scott Melker discusses if going public is really about stock price going up, quoting Dan Held that IPOs give liquidity and hedging ways, disappointing Kraken hasn't IPO'd yet, noting Coinbase is down 50% from IPO and public markets mean active trading and liquidity not just number go up.
text:
Is going public really about the stock price going up?

Dan Held says IPOs give shareholders liquidity and ways to hedge, and calls it disappointing that Kraken still hasn't gone public

"Kraken, I'm thrilled to see how far it's come from 2019 all the way through today. Coinbase, I think, will always be a little bit bigger, but Kraken is agile."

"I can't deny it's a little disappointing they haven't IPO'd yet. Plenty of companies IPO, and the price goes horizontal for months or years, or goes down. Coinbase is down 50% from the IPO."

"Public markets simply means that the price is actively traded, employees get liquidity, and you can do more sophisticated things like write covered calls, buy calls, buy puts. So it's not really about if number go up."

name: Shay Boloor

ticker_notes.TSLA: 與 SpaceX/xAI 構建龐大 AI 基建生態系統
ticker_notes.SPCX: 與 Tesla 整合構建 AI 基建

zh_summary: 我認為 $TSLA 和 $SPCX 最被忽視的部分之一是它們已在構建可能成為一個龐大 AI 基礎設施生態系統的東西。SpaceX 和 xAI 已購買約 10 億美元的 Tesla 產品，包括為 Colossus II 購買約 6.99 億美元的 Megapacks，而他們現在正計劃約 170 億美元的 Terafab，Starlink 將整合到 Cybercab 中，Grok 將為 Tesla 的車載 AI 提供動力。再加上 Optimus 人形機器人在工廠和發射場工作，以及軌道計算的計劃，你就會開始看到 Elon Inc. 的樣子：Tesla 供應電力和芯片，Starship 發射數據中心，Starlink 連接它們。
en_summary: I think one of most overlooked parts of $TSLA and $SPCX is how they're already building what could become one massive AI infrastructure ecosystem. SpaceX and xAI have already bought ~$1B of Tesla products including ~$699M in Megapacks for Colossus II while they're now planning a ~$17B Terafab with Starlink being integrated into Cybercab and Grok powering Tesla's in-car AI. And when you add Optimus humanoids working across factories and launch sites alongside plans for orbital compute then you start to see what Elon Inc. could look like with Tesla supplying the power and chips while Starship launches the data centers and Starlink connects them.

en_summary: Selloff in $NBIS, $CRWV and $IREN looks extreme heading into November as $NVDA B300 rental prices up 52% since May and H100s also more expensive. AI token prices halved from peak, showing pricing power. $IREN secured $363M against contracted GPUs, Nebius expects over $9B in prepayments.
text:
Heading into November I think the selloff in $NBIS, $CRWV and $IREN is getting a bit extreme when $NVDA B300 rental prices are up 52% since May and even older H100s are getting more expensive to rent.

Meanwhile AI token prices have fallen more than half from their peak which tells you a lot about where real pricing power sits in AI economy.

And while market worries about financing IREN just secured $363M against contracted GPUs and Nebius expects over $9B in customer prepayments which shows capital is still available for operators with real demand.
